field.name: TrackerPort.readSignoffRequest and TrackerPort.readSignoffState(since)
field.type: readSignoffRequest?(ref: SignoffRequestRef): PortResult<{ branch: string; open: boolean }>; readSignoffState(ref: SignoffRequestRef, since?: string): PortResult<'open' | 'changes-requested' | 'completed'>
field.purpose: A resubmission has to decide between pushing to an existing request and opening a new one, so the port says which branch a request was opened from and whether it can still take pushes. readSignoffState also takes the time the latest submission was recorded: a changes-requested decision counts only when each reviewer's latest decisive review (APPROVED, CHANGES_REQUESTED or DISMISSED; COMMENTED ignored) asks for changes and was made after that time, because on GitHub the decision on an earlier push lingers until the reviewer re-reviews. Both are optional and additive; a caller that passes no `since` gets today's answer.

body.rationale: Without the branch and openness read, a request asked for changes cannot be told from a closed one; without `since`, the first settle after a resubmission would record signoff-changes on the new revision at once and a later merge would never be recorded.
